overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep, relatable relationship dynamics—specifically husband-wife bonds and everyday relationship realism—significantly outperform general sad shayari or fragmented emotional categories. Top videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1679 views) prove that marital/relationship realism is the core driver of engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage dynamics and spousal understanding achieved the highest views (1,770 and 1,679 views respectively).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dilemmas, unspoken expectations, and emotional distance in long-term bonds.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sad Shayari & Overtly Poetic Framing
weak_patterns.evidence: Poetic or heavy philosophical lines like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…' received very low traction (21 views).
weak_patterns.action: Move away from abstract poetry and focus on grounded, conversational everyday observations.
